column1: # Deliberately not named *.manifest: the global gitignore inherits that
# pattern from a Python template, which would silently keep this file out of
# the repository and leave link.sh with nothing to read.
#   source  relative to the repository root; `-` for `dir` rows
#   target  absolute; a leading `~` is expanded to $HOME by link.sh
# Every row has all three fields. `dir` rows use `-` rather than an empty
# column because tab is an IFS whitespace character: bash collapses two
# adjacent tabs into a single delimiter, which would silently shift the
# Fields are TAB-separated, so paths containing spaces need no quoting.
# Blank lines and lines starting with `#` are ignored — a disabled entry
# stays here as a commented row rather than being deleted.
# link.sh creates each target's parent directory automatically; `dir` rows
# are only for directories that are not the parent of any entry below.
# --- directories with no entries of their own ---------------------------
# NOTE: source is the OSX keymap but the target filename says Linux. This
# mirrors the pre-manifest link.sh exactly; see the plan doc's open questions.
